home.startFirst: Dze wò dodokpɔ gbãtɔ gɔme fifia.
tips: Mègatsɔ wò PIN alo OTP kɔdi gbeɖe na ame aɖeke o, kpɔɖeŋu aɖeke mele eme o.
Ame aɖe be yedo ga na wò le vodada me? Kpɔ wò akɔnta le USSD se dzi gbã.
Kɔmpaniwo meɖoa link be woaxɔ nunana alo bonus gbeɖe o.
Tsi kaƒoƒoa ne wole kaba wɔm na wò : dɔwɔla vavã ate ŋu alala.

guide.title: Gbeɖiɖi Léle Mɔfiame
guide.subtitle: Srɔ̃ ale si nàlé kaƒoƒo vɔ̃ɖiwo dedie le Togo sewo nu.
guide.legalNotice: Se kple Agbenyuinɔnɔ Mɔnu: Lé kaƒoƒo ne èle beble vɔ̃ɖi aɖe dzesi kpɔm ko be nàkpɔ ɖokuiwò ta. CyberSafe meléa naneke ne mèɖe mɔ o.
androidSteps: Kpɔe ɖa ne wò kaƒomɔ̃ teƒe kpɔ 'Lé gbe' dzesi esime nèle ka ƒom.
Ne mele eme o la, do gbea ɖe gblɔ eye nàzã kaƒomɔ̃ bubu ƒe gbelemɔ̃.
Mègaɖo mɔ̃ bubu madzemadzewo siwo bia mɔɖeɖe vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖe wò mɔ̃ dzi o.
iosSteps: Le iOS 18.1+ dzi la, zi gbeɖiɖi léle dzesi si le etame miame esime kaƒoƒoa le edzi.
Alo do gbea ɖe gblɔ eye nàzã tablet alo xɔlɔ̃ aɖe ƒe Dictaphone.
Kɔ gbea vɛ afisia be nàkpɔ eme le CyberSafe Online me.
guide.whatNext: Nu ka nàwɔ le gbea léle megbe?
guide.whatNextDesc: Tsi kaƒoƒoa kaba ne amea bia wò PIN alo do vɔvɔ̃ na wò. Kɔ gbea vɛ alo ŋlɔ nya si wogblɔ ɖe míaƒe mɔ̃a me.

about.title: CyberSafe Online Ŋuti Nyatakaka
about.subtitle: Mɔ̃ vovovo zãlawo katã ƒe dedienɔnɔ mɔ̃ le Togo.
about.missionDesc: Wowɔ CyberSafe Online be wòakpɔ Togo dukɔmevi ɖesiaɖe ta tso T-Money, Moov Money kple asitsamɔ̃ dzi beble vɔ̃ɖiwo nu.
about.multilingualDesc: Le CyberSafe Online sedede nu la, míezã Fransegbe, Eŋlisigbe kple Eʋegbe tso gɔmedzedzea me ke. CyberSafe AI mɔ̃ kple dɔwɔnuwo nyana ale si Togo dukɔmeviwo fona gbe vovovowo tsakana (code-switching).
about.safetyDesc: Míele to ameɖe gbeɖom le megbe o, eye míele gbe ɖem le megbe o. Nyatakaka si nèɖo ɖa hena dodokpɔ la, woaɖo ɖe CyberSafe dɔwɔƒe me; URL siwo woɖe le eme ate ŋu ayi VirusTotal me ne wòɖe eŋu. Mègatsɔ PIN alo OTP ɖo eŋu o.

settings.privacyDescription: Wò gbe, tema kple dodokpɔ ƒe ŋutinya la wodzra ɖo le wò browser me. Nyatakaka alo document si nèɖo ɖa hena dodokpɔ la, woaɖo ɖe CyberSafe dɔwɔƒe me eye IA dɔwɔƒe ate ŋu awɔ dɔ kplii; URL siwo woɖe le eme ate ŋu ayi VirusTotal me ne wòɖe eŋu. Mègatsɔ PIN alo OTP ɖo eŋu o.
